meta.title: ImageGPT API
meta.description: Unified REST API for generating text, images, video, and audio from 40+ AI models through a single endpoint with credit-based pricing.

authentication.notes: Every request must include your API key in the x-api-key header. A missing or invalid key returns 401 Unauthorized.

text-generation.title: Text Generation API
text-generation.overview: A unified REST API to generate text using 20+ AI models from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Perplexity, and more — all through a single endpoint with a credit-based pricing system.

endpoints.description: Generate text / chat completions from a prompt.

requestBody.name: model
requestBody.description: Model ID to use for generation. See the model list below for all available IDs.

requestBody.name: prompt
requestBody.description: The user prompt / instruction to send to the model.

requestBody.name: system
requestBody.description: Optional system message to set the model's behavior or persona.

requestBody.name: outputType
requestBody.description: Output format. Use "text" for plain text or "json" to receive a structured JSON response.

requestBody.name: maxTokens
requestBody.description: Maximum number of output tokens to generate. Minimum value is 100.

responses.example: A plain text string from the model.

notes: When using outputType: "json", instruct the model in your prompt to respond in valid JSON format for best results.

examples.label: Text completion (fetch)

pricing.notes: Input tokens are always free. The credit value shown per model is charged per 1,000 output tokens.

image-generation.title: Image Generation API
image-generation.overview: A unified REST API to generate images using 15+ AI models — supporting text-to-image and image-to-image generation with multiple output formats, all through a single endpoint with a credit-based pricing system.

endpoints.description: Generate an image from a text prompt.
Generate an image from one or more input images (image-to-image).

requestBody.name: model
requestBody.description: Model ID to use for generation. See the model list below for all available IDs.

requestBody.name: prompt
requestBody.description: Text description of the image you want to generate.

requestBody.name: width
requestBody.description: Output image width in pixels.

requestBody.name: height
requestBody.description: Output image height in pixels.

requestBody.name: outputType
requestBody.description: Output delivery format. One of "binary" (image blob), "url" (hosted link), or "base64" (encoded string).

requestBody.name: outputFormat
requestBody.description: Image file format. Either "png" or "jpg".

requestBody.name: image
requestBody.description: Array of input image URLs (max 3). Required only for image-to-image generation.

responses.example:
const blob = await response.blob();
const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

examples.label: Text-to-image (fetch)
Image-to-image (body)

pricing.notes: Each image deducts the credit value shown for the selected model.

video-generation.title: Video Generation API
video-generation.overview: A unified REST API to generate videos from text prompts or images using 7+ AI models. Video generation is asynchronous — submitting a request returns a task ID, and you poll a separate status endpoint until the video is ready.

endpoints.description: Submit a text-to-video task. Returns a taskId immediately.
Submit an image-to-video task. Returns a taskId immediately.
Poll task status. Query params: taskId, outputType (url|binary).

query.name: taskId
query.description: The task ID from the create response.

query.name: outputType
query.description: "url" returns JSON with a hosted video URL; "binary" returns the raw video file.

requestBody.name: model
requestBody.description: Model ID to use for generation, e.g. KLING-3.0-TURBO, SEEDANCE-2.0-MINI, WAN-2.7-VIDEO, HAILUO-2.3, GROK-IMAGINE-VIDEO-1.5, GEMINI-OMNI, HAPPYHORSE-1.1.

requestBody.name: prompt
requestBody.description: Text description of the video (or, for image-video, how the image should be animated).

requestBody.name: duration
requestBody.description: Length of the video in seconds. Valid values depend on the selected model (e.g. 4–15s, or fixed 6/10s for some models).

requestBody.name: resolution
requestBody.description: Output resolution. One of "480p", "720p", or "1080p" depending on model support — pricing varies per resolution.

requestBody.name: aspect_ratio
requestBody.description: Output aspect ratio. One of "16:9", "9:16", or "1:1".

requestBody.name: image
requestBody.description: Array containing the source image URL. Required only for image-to-video generation (/generate/image-video).

responses.description: Returns JSON. status is "waiting" while rendering, then "success" with a hosted video url once done.
Returns the raw video file directly once it's ready (no JSON wrapper).
responses.example:
const blob = await response.blob();
const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);

notes: Video rendering can take anywhere from several seconds to a few minutes depending on duration, resolution, and model. Poll on an interval (e.g. every 3-5s) rather than in a tight loop.

examples.label: Text-to-video (create)
Image-to-video (body)
examples.code:
body: JSON.stringify({
  model: 'WAN-2.7-VIDEO',
  prompt: 'Animate the scene with gentle camera movement',
  image: ['https://example.com/input.jpg'],
  duration: 5,
  resolution: '1080p',
  aspect_ratio: '9:16'
})

pricing.notes: The per-second rate depends on both the model and the chosen resolution. Total cost = credits/second × duration.

audio-generation.title: Audio (Text to Speech) API
audio-generation.overview: Convert text to natural-sounding audio using models from Qwen3, ElevenLabs, and OpenAI — all through a single endpoint with a credit-based pricing system.

requestBody.name: prompt
requestBody.description: The text you want to convert to speech.

requestBody.name: model
requestBody.description: Model ID to use. E.g. QWEN3/TTS-FLASH, ELEVENLABS/TTS, OPENAI/GPT-AUDIO-MINI.

requestBody.name: outputType
requestBody.description: Use "binary" to receive raw audio bytes, or "url" to get a hosted audio URL in JSON.

requestBody.name: voice
requestBody.description: Voice name (applies to OpenAI and ElevenLabs models only). E.g. alloy, nova, rachel, josh.

requestBody.name: outputFormat
requestBody.description: Audio format for the output (applies to OpenAI and ElevenLabs models only). Currently mp3.

responses.example: Raw audio bytes (mp3 stream). Save directly to a file or create a Blob URL.

examples.label: Text-to-speech (fetch)
